info.title: CCTV Video Analytics Platform Control Plane API
info.description:
Enterprise Backend Control Plane and Orchestration REST Web API for AI Computer Vision, Spatial Asset Management, User Management, and Multi-Tenant CCTV Video Analytics.

### Authentication & Tenant Isolation
* **Multi-Tenant Header**: Send `X-Tenant-Id: e078ee93-90c4-4b95-9651-7bf82c8a6d33` on all tenant-scoped requests. In Development mode, it defaults to this GUID if omitted.
* **JWT Authorization**: Bearer token support via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` obtained from `/api/v1/auth/login`.

### Core Functional Clusters
1. **Authentication & Users**: JWT Login, current user profile (`/auth/me`), and user CRUD operations with role assignments.
2. **Spatial Hierarchy**: Site -> Building -> Floor -> Room -> Camera -> Zone.
3. **Analytics Plugin Catalog**: Modules library, CUDA requirements, entry points, and live toggles.
4. **Pipeline Orchestration**: Assignment of camera video streams to AI Engine worker nodes.
5. **Engine Lifecycle & Remote Control**: Remote runtime commands, bootstrap synchronization, and heartbeats.
6. **Health Scoring & Telemetry**: AI Engine hardware utilization, inference FPS, latency, and health scoring.
7. **Live Observability & Snapshot**: JPEG frame uploads with AI bounding-box overlay metadata.
